rawContent: Watching @VezzieT talking “Networked Feminist Counter-publics and the Intersectional Issues of #MeToo” #aoir2019

@VezzieT In watching #metoo unfold, @VezzieT noticed people talking about feeling conflicted about whether to share their experiences and also people trying to draw attention to the phrases’ origins. This led to an interest in counter-publics w/in the movement

A key result from the keyword search was a lack of intersectional narratives. But it's important to remember that these were tweets from the very start of #metoo. It may have changed over time. 

@VezzieT #aoir2019

Looking at a network view of all the tweets shows that the woman’s march was very central to the movement while Tarana Burke was more peripheral. Again though, these are only tweets from the first day of #metoo 

@VezzieT #aoir2019
